insight: Raised a $40M Series B in Nov 2025 at a $225M valuation (Greylock-led), pivoting hard into AI-search visibility.
name: AirOps
tagline: AI-search visibility platform: track citations and ship optimized content at scale.
description: AirOps helps marketing teams win visibility across AI answer engines and traditional search. It tracks brand citations and share-of-voice across ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Gemini, then runs an AI agent (Quill) that drafts and refreshes content against brand guidelines and gap analysis.
edge: Pairs AI-answer-engine citation tracking with a content agent that drafts to close the visibility gaps it finds.
cons: Newer GEO category, metrics still maturing
